content: pnpm 10+ blocks native postinstall scripts by default; better-sqlite3 must be added to allow-list or .npmrc with 'build-from-source=better-sqlite3'. ARM64 requires build-essential and python3 in build stage. Multi-stage builds must copy node_modules correctly. Always test on ARM64 hardware before shipping. BuildKit cache mounts (RUN --mount=type=cache,id=pnpm,target=/pnpm/store) critical for rebuild speed.
